% Saha equation (pure hydrogen, LTE)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C4_Saha}
\frac{x_e^{2}}{1 - x_e} = \frac{1}{n_H}\,\left(\frac{m_e k_B T}{2\pi\hbar^{2}}\right)^{3/2}e^{-\chi_H / k_B T}
\end{equation}

% Ohmic diffusivity (Draine 1983 table fit)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C4_eta_O}
\eta_O \approx 234\,\sqrt{\tfrac{T}{10^{4}\,\mathrm{K}}}\,x_e^{-1}\ \mathrm{cm^{2}/s}\qquad\text{(pure H, LTE)}
\end{equation}

% Ambipolar diffusivity
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C4_eta_A}
\eta_A = \frac{|\mathbf{B}|^{2}}{\rho_i\,\rho_n\,\gamma_{in}},\quad \gamma_{in} \approx 3.5\times 10^{13}\ \mathrm{cm^{3}/g/s}\ \text{(H-H+ drag coefficient)}
\end{equation}

% Weakly-ionised limit (x_e → 0)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C4_weak_ion}
\eta_A \sim \frac{|\mathbf{B}|^{2}}{x_e\,\rho^{2}\,\gamma_{in}},\quad \eta_O \sim \frac{234\,\sqrt{T/10^{4}\text{K}}}{x_e}\ \Rightarrow\ \text{both diffusivities diverge as }x_e\to 0.
\end{equation}

% Magnetic Reynolds numbers
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C4_Rm}
R_m^{\mathrm{Ohm}} = \frac{L\,v_A}{\eta_O},\qquad R_m^{\mathrm{amb}} = \frac{L\,v_A\,\rho}{\eta_A\,|\mathbf{B}|^{2}}
\end{equation}

% Ideal-MHD validity criterion
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C4_Rm_criterion}
R_m \gg 1\ \text{for ideal MHD};\ R_m \lesssim 1\ \text{means the corresponding non-ideal term dominates.}\ \text{Matsuoka et al.\ 2024 report } R_m \sim 1\text{–}10\text{ in the chromosphere at } r \approx 1000\ \mathrm{km}.
\end{equation}
